name: Weighted Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the plate against your chest with one hand.
Rest your free hand on a wall for balance, rise onto your forefeet and tighten your glutes to keep your hips extended.
Drive your knees smoothly forward while leaning your torso backward in one straight line from knees to shoulders.
Press powerfully through the balls of your feet and quads to extend your knees back to the upright starting stance.
tips: Keep your hips fully extended rather than folding backward from your lower back.
Use a light plate and hold a wall or sturdy chair lightly with your free hand if extra balance is needed.
